goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Attacks whoever taunted it, then the Warrior, then the lowest-HP target. Passive: Pack Tactics gives +1 damage for each other goblin on the field

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Smashes whoever taunted it, else the Warrior. Special: Ground Slam hits every hero for its damage −2 and knocks its target prone

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.description: Goes after the Wizard or Cleric (lowest HP). Special: Hex curses the party (−2 damage for 2 turns) and deals 3 to every hero, ignoring armor

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Ranged: ignores taunts and targets the lowest-armor hero. Special: Volley hits the two lowest-armor heroes

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Targets the lowest-HP hero; each hit drains 2 energy. Special: Execute deals double damage to a hero below half HP

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.description: Heals the most injured monster and shields the horde (+2 armor through next round). Arrives with wave 1. Guarded by the Pack: can't be targeted while 2 or more goblins are alive (attacks that hit every enemy still land). Special: War Drum gives every monster +2 damage that round, timed with wave 2's goblin pack
